Borrow SQLite row text during exact canonical JSON projection to remove temporary owned text copies. Preserve the original field ordering, duplicate-column result, real-number encoding, escaped-byte budgets and error order.

This remains a Draft against the fixed review base `fffd950d5b34b0180f308db1428a57d5bf358bf1`. Current head is **`f6750cad0df45af4ec2dddc456e76cc188f3a35a`**. It is a normal fast-forward of the previously prepared P/R/G chain from formatter-only head `9ddae045f6925140a4d652c5f28f64add459eff1`, adding the separate equal-lifetime ignored diagnostic and dedicated workflow. All prior production serialization, regular controls, the original ignored probe and its workflow remain byte-preserved.

## Historical correctness verification at 9ddae

All three jobs in [ordinary CI run 37961137036](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37961137036) passed; the [main check](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37961137036/job/113923960385) finished at **2026-10-09 17:48:54 UTC**. Its complete original log and independent review are retained. The actual PR test-merge tree exactly equals the reviewed head tree `20ae2605cad47e1b56c80e5f83278bbd34744982`.

Formatting, Clippy, all-target compilation, authorized regressions and the original source/task guards passed. Each of the four new controls actually passed in both default and eval-http executions:

- Reordered and duplicate columns produce the original bytes.
- Escaped byte lengths preserve row-boundary budgets.
- SELECT errors retain their order and subsequent recovery behavior.
- Real values retain the original Value encoding.

The finite ignored cost probe remained ignored in these ordinary regression executions.

## Cost observations and adoption decision

**Adoption was held at the original cost review; current-main integration remains pending.** The original cost study is [run 37956976406](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/37956976406), source **`eded24951c3e99693410ce959a627ab575f66bec`**. It retains all **100 measurements: five cases × 20 alternating-order pairs**, with complete byte assertions. No observations were trimmed.

The four smaller/blob cases were faster in all 20 pairs. The `multiple_text` case had median paired borrowed/original ratio **1.0664289** and was faster in only 10/20 pairs. Ordering matters: its medians were 1.2050854 with original-first and 0.9557795 with borrowed-first. The first side's result vector also remained live while the second side was timed. These observations do not establish an end-to-end parity or indexing improvement.

The previously archived equal-lifetime candidate was published by normal fast-forward on 2026-10-09 at 23:22:51 UTC. The sole new `p8-oracle-equal-lifetime-cost-run` label was added at 23:23:16 UTC to request its independently named bounded observation. This is not a rerun, correction or replacement of the original 100-pair study. The new workflow directly checks out head `f6750cad…`; the new ordinary test-merge `17cef1ccd9eb51099e0aed9faab466edb28316fc` has parents `[fffd950d…, f6750cad…]` and the exact complete head tree `4d49ddd5e61b9b32f2677a9966c3326c336aec0e`.

The existing protocol retains five cases × 20 alternating-order pairs and 256 rows per side. Both sides keep one common immutable reference; each side verifies, hashes and drops its own result vector before the next timer. Allocator/cache/order effects remain explicit. The workflow retains source/toolchain/observer identities, complete outputs, producer metadata and the executed ELF's post-run hash; it does not archive ELF bytes, so independent later ELF-byte rehash is unavailable from that artifact alone. At publication time, no new diagnostic result or new-head CI success had been claimed. The independently verified terminal diagnostic is recorded below; ordinary new-head CI remains a separate record.

The label-event review confirms only the new observation job matches that label. The separate head update also starts the repository's ordinary new-head CI, including runtime/soak, under their existing conditions. Those runs keep their new source identities and do not replace the three original scale/cold studies.

## Actual equal-lifetime observation and next integration step

The independently named [run 38004163561, attempt 1](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/actions/runs/38004163561) completed successfully at source `f6750cad0df45af4ec2dddc456e76cc188f3a35a`. The original Cargo child exited 0 and libtest reported 1 passed / 0 failed / 0 ignored. Its exact full log and original artifact `11650632746` were retained once, followed by a nonauthor analysis that actually exited 0.

All 100 unique pairs, five cases × 20 pairs × 256 rows, were accepted. All original/borrowed/reference digests match after the native full-row equality assertions. Each case retains ten pairs for each execution order. Ratios below are descriptive paired `borrowed_ns / original_ns`; no performance threshold was added.

| Case | All 20-pair median | Original-first median | Borrowed-first median | Faster / slower pairs |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| multiple_text | 0.960259 | 0.952529 | 0.977407 | 18 / 2 |
| short_fields | 0.830247 | 0.826431 | 0.837201 | 20 / 0 |
| blob | 0.937696 | 0.935336 | 0.943234 | 20 / 0 |
| empty_text | 0.884909 | 0.873277 | 0.895401 | 19 / 1 |
| null | 0.867901 | 0.840527 | 0.882010 | 18 / 2 |

All five slower pairs are retained, including the largest ratio 1.172166 for null round 4. The data supports the finite mechanism direction on these constructed inputs. Timers include SELECT traversal, serialization and output retention, and the remaining allocation/cache history is not reset. It does not identify isolated sub-costs, establish that output lifetime caused the old result, or prove current-main, 100k or end-to-end gains. The old v1 results remain unchanged and separate.

[Complete original ZIP, job log, terminal API records, independent verdict and full analysis](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/07308326c3a658bc3f0e8d0cae85f9218bf960fe/artifacts/checkpoints/p8-round30-PR190-equal-lifetime-bfcc-20261009) are now durable. The original producer records a fresh release cc_eval test executable of 28,876,408 bytes, SHA256 `fc5ac08708626b1cee63de1a19c0e98de30c8a264059297f476dd4ef1f844696`; this protocol does not archive ELF bytes or per-row raw outputs.

Root has accepted this finite diagnostic and is preparing a separate reviewed integration onto current main `09d4454fa45455dc5a8bfdfec67e31bb7ed162c7`, carrying the exact oracle implementation and correctness tests. This fixed-base PR remains Draft until that integration is actually verified and reconciled. No original scale run, plan, threshold or task status changes accompany that preparation.

[The original public source-admission archive](https://github.com/jyqj/codecortex/tree/e5d381667d19922b006f45075fc077f8a73197c3/artifacts/checkpoints) retains the earlier fixed reviews and execution receipts.
